title: Mean time to revoke — identity compromise containment
summary: Time between detection firing and the completion of MFA reset + session revocation across IdP and downstream SaaS. Measures how fast the operator evicts an active attacker once compromise is suspected. Lower is better.

target.rationale: Containment SLA aligned with NIS2 Art. 23 early-warning expectation (24h) and DORA Art. 19 initial report (4h) by leaving operator headroom for downstream reporting.

measurement.formula: p95( reset_mfa_and_revoke_sessions.end_time - triage_identity_signal.end_time ) over identity-compromise incidents within window.

inputs.name: triage_end
inputs.description: completion time of the triage step that confirmed compromise

inputs.name: revoke_end
inputs.description: completion time of the MFA-reset + session-revocation step

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation Article 19 — reporting of major ICT-related incidents
